xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for #3660 panel ceiling and dual-stop accounting; bound SoT successor lean 5390368619.

plan.title: fix(design-critique): parallel critics must share one input ceiling; state the N=3 dual-stop reading and make the ceiling durable

narratives.Description: The contract's ceiling and dual-stop rules are written for one critic at a time. A panel is N critics in one round and nothing describes it. Three things land: same-round critics MUST share one issue-comment input ceiling fixed before any sibling dispatch; the round-1 thread-head fallback is scoped so it cannot apply to parallel siblings; and the N=3 dual-stop reading is written down. A durable machine-checkable record of the shared ceiling is added so the rule is verifiable rather than hollow.
narratives.Overview: Bound SoT is successor lean 5390368619; synthesis accepted 5390385927. All line numbers in the bound body are derived at 7f2639cc -- #3651 merged mid-arc and shifted the Dual stop cluster. Re-derive with `git grep -n` before editing; a PowerShell line-counter disagreed with git on this file. Shared file content/contracts/design-critique.md is contended with #3661 (disjoint regions, file contention only). This cohort sequences #3660 first, then #3661 -- do not parallelize.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, design, process, area:skills, status:child, design-critique:triage-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a parent dispatching a panel of critics in one round, I want the contract to state one shared input ceiling and a durable record of it, so that a panel cannot silently degrade into a sequential chain while still being reported as N independent critics.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add the shared-ceiling MUST to the Stop 3 envelope-and-ceiling rules (measured at 7f2639cc as :78-81): critics dispatched in the same round share one issue-comment input ceiling, fixed before any sibling dispatch; a sibling's post is out of envelope for every other sibling in that round. 2. Scope :80's 'or the thread head at dispatch' so it cannot apply to parallel siblings -- either restrict it to a single-critic round with no triage write-back, or define one round-start snapshot taken before the first sibling dispatch. 3. State the N=3 standing reading near Dual stop (:206-211): an N=3 panel is permitted three round-1 posts and no default retry; a fourth post requires the operator to raise the cap for the arc and record it. Record N>3 as unaddressed. 4. Add a durable ceiling deposit -- either a required `input-ceiling: <comment-id>` line in each critic post's lead block, or a parent panel-deposit comment naming round id, sibling count and shared ceiling before dispatch. The choice is the implementer's; state which was chosen and why. 5. Record round-3+ ceiling, amendment supersession, pass-4 accounting and the parallel fingerprint as audited residuals with their working defaults -- not as rules. Now that ## Parent-side substantiation has landed, a parent leaning on either open default must carry an audit marker. 6. Pin the shared-ceiling sentence, the narrowed fallback and the N=3 sentence in design_critique_contract.test.ts -- content, not headers. 7. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line. Bound SoT: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3660#issuecomment-5390368619.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Successor lean 5390368619 is bound SoT; synthesis accepted 5390385927. The N=3 dual-stop reading is DECIDED by derivation from :210-211, not deferred -- do not re-open it. The shared-ceiling MUST must NOT claim decorrelation; it only prevents siblings reading each other through the issue thread. Out of scope: deciding the round-3+ ceiling, amendment supersession, the N>3 budget, pass-4 accounting, and the parallel fingerprint -- all recorded as residuals. Mechanical independence enforcement (serving each critic a truncated snapshot) stays out per #3434. Concurrent-agent thread interlock is #3607.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Nine clauses match the bound issue checklist. Each is independently pin-testable; two of them (shared ceiling, N=3 reading) are the substance of the critique.

items.title: Same-round critics share one issue-comment input ceiling

narrative.When: When critics are dispatched in the same round, the contract states as a MUST that they share one issue-comment input ceiling fixed before any sibling dispatch, and that a sibling's post is out of envelope for every other sibling in that round.
narrative.Acceptance: When critics are dispatched in the same round, the contract states as a MUST that they share one issue-comment input ceiling fixed before any sibling dispatch, and that a sibling's post is out of envelope for every other sibling in that round.

items.title: The MUST does not overclaim independence

narrative.When: When the shared-ceiling MUST is read, it claims only that siblings cannot read each other through the issue thread, and does not assert decorrelation.
narrative.Acceptance: When the shared-ceiling MUST is read, it claims only that siblings cannot read each other through the issue thread, and does not assert decorrelation.

items.title: Thread-head fallback cannot apply to parallel siblings

narrative.When: When the round-1 ceiling rule is read, its 'or the thread head at dispatch' fallback is scoped so it cannot apply to parallel sibling dispatch.
narrative.Acceptance: When the round-1 ceiling rule is read, its 'or the thread head at dispatch' fallback is scoped so it cannot apply to parallel sibling dispatch.

narrative.When: When Dual stop is read, it states that an N=3 panel is permitted three round-1 posts with no default retry, and that a fourth post requires a recorded operator cap raise.
narrative.Acceptance: When Dual stop is read, it states that an N=3 panel is permitted three round-1 posts with no default retry, and that a fourth post requires a recorded operator cap raise.

narrative.When: When the N=3 reading is read, the contract records that panels larger than three are unaddressed rather than silently covered by it.
narrative.Acceptance: When the N=3 reading is read, the contract records that panels larger than three are unaddressed rather than silently covered by it.

narrative.When: When a panel round is dispatched, a durable record of the shared ceiling exists that a content-contract pin can check for malformation, and the chosen shape is stated with its reason.
narrative.Acceptance: When a panel round is dispatched, a durable record of the shared ceiling exists that a content-contract pin can check for malformation, and the chosen shape is stated with its reason.

items.title: Content-contract test pins content, not headers

narrative.Acceptance: When the content-contract test runs, it pins the shared-ceiling sentence, the narrowed fallback and the N=3 sentence rather than section headings.

acceptance.derived_reason: Nine clauses taken verbatim from the bound issue checklist at https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3660 after synthesis was accepted.

clauses.text: Same-round critics share one issue-comment input ceiling, fixed before any sibling dispatch, stated as a MUST
The MUST does not claim decorrelation -- only that siblings cannot read each other through the thread
The round-1 'or the thread head at dispatch' fallback is scoped so it cannot apply to parallel siblings
The N=3 standing reading is stated: three round-1 posts permitted, no default retry, post four needs a recorded cap raise
N>3 is recorded as unaddressed rather than silently covered by the N=3 reading
A durable, machine-checkable record of the shared ceiling exists; which of the two shapes is a build-time choice
Content-contract test pins the shared-ceiling sentence, the narrowed fallback and the N=3 sentence -- content, not headers
Round-3+ ceiling, amendment supersession, pass-4 accounting and the parallel fingerprint are recorded as audited residuals with their working defaults, not as rules
